title: Ballet Partnering Basics: Balance & Support | Pas de Deux Tips: Episode 1

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, technical instructions while emphasizing the importance of safety and partnership. He uses demonstrations with students to illustrate both correct and incorrect techniques.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction of the series and the instructor.
Prerequisites for learning pas de deux.
Explanation of weight distribution and hand placement.

cues: Lift up in your lower abs
common_mistakes: Trying to stay on leg by yourself
safety: People can roll their ankles if they get uncomfortable
It becomes very dangerous if you are not strong in your point work

steps_taught.name: Soutenu balance
steps_taught.description: A balance where the partner is taken off and on their legs.

what_works: Demonstrations of both correct and incorrect techniques
what_hinders: The advanced nature of the dance style

quotes.text: The most important thing that I tell the women in pas de deux class is that they have to hold their placement.
You don't want to grab or grip, right? You're taking them gently in your palms.
I don't necessarily care how you look in the beginning.
The woman's job in classical pas de deux is to maintain that placement no matter what.
Notice they're only taking them off as much as the ladies can control.
